ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the problem stem: the solution set of the inequality ax-b<0 is (1,+∞). Write ax-b<0 as a(x-b/a)<0. Because the solution set is x>1, the coefficient of the linear term must satisfy a<0, and the critical point b/a=1, therefore b=a. Substitute b=a into the inequality to be found: (ax+b)(x-3)>0, obtaining (ax+a)(x-3)>0, that is, a(x+1)(x-3)>0. Since a<0, when dividing both sides by a, the direction of the inequality sign changes, obtaining (x+1)(x-3)<0. This quadratic inequality holds between the two roots -1 and 3, so -1<x<3.

method.method_draft: 先从题干文字读出：不等式 ax-b<0 的解集为 (1,+∞)。把 ax-b<0 改写为 a(x-b/a)<0。由于解集是 x>1，必须有 a<0，且临界点 b/a=1，所以 b=a。代入待求不等式：(ax+b)(x-3)=a(x+1)(x-3)>0。因为 a<0，两边除以 a 时不等号反向，得到 (x+1)(x-3)<0，因此 -1<x<3，解集为 (-1,3)。
